from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,re,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
try:
 ROOT=Path.cwd(); PROD=Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'
 DEMO='control/dev_checks/project_executor_demo_e001.py'
 INTENDED=['control/codex_supervisor/build_planner.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_nonbuildable_components.py','tests/control/test_build_planner_retry.py','knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json']
 planner_dst=ROOT/INTENDED[0]
 base_sha=hashlib.sha256(planner_dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if planner_dst.is_file() else None
 def gp(*args):
  cp=subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=PROD,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  assert cp.returncode==0,cp.stdout[-1200:]
  return [x.strip() for x in cp.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
 def allowed(rel):
  if rel==DEMO or rel.startswith('control/project_tasks/') or rel.startswith('control/bridge_commands/inbox/'): return False
  return rel.startswith('control/') or rel.startswith('tests/') or rel=='knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json'
 for rel in sorted(set(gp('diff','--name-only','HEAD'))|set(gp('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'))):
  if not allowed(rel): continue
  src=PROD/rel; dst=ROOT/rel
  if src.is_file(): dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(src,dst)
 for rel in INTENDED:
  src=PROD/rel; dst=ROOT/rel
  assert src.is_file(),'REQUIRED_LOCAL_FILE_MISSING:'+rel
  dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(src,dst)
 planner=ROOT/INTENDED[0]; text=planner.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 for marker in ['For REQUIRES_SHARED_INFRA or INSUFFICIENT_SPEC, components MUST be an empty list []','NONBUILDABLE_COMPONENTS_MUST_BE_EMPTY','BUILD_PLANNER_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED','BUILD_PLANNER_COMPLETE_WITHOUT_STATE_ADVANCE']:
  assert marker in text,'PLANNER_MARKER_MISSING:'+marker
 new_sha=hashlib.sha256(planner.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); cfg=ROOT/INTENDED[3]; raw=cfg.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 if new_sha not in raw:
  candidates=[]
  if base_sha and raw.count(base_sha)==1: candidates=[base_sha]
  if not candidates:
   for m in re.finditer(r'[0-9a-fA-F]{64}',raw):
    lo=max(0,m.start()-160); hi=min(len(raw),m.end()+160); window=raw[lo:hi].lower()
    if 'build_planner' in window: candidates.append(m.group(0))
   candidates=list(dict.fromkeys(candidates))
  assert len(candidates)==1,'BUILD_PLANNER_OLD_PIN_COUNT:'+str(len(candidates))
  old=candidates[0]; assert raw.count(old)==1,'BUILD_PLANNER_OLD_PIN_NOT_UNIQUE'
  cfg.write_text(raw.replace(old,new_sha,1),encoding='utf-8')
 assert new_sha in cfg.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'BUILD_PLANNER_PIN_NOT_UPDATED'
 print('PREPARE_PASS')
except BaseException as exc:
 msg=' '.join(str(exc).split())[:800]
 raise SystemExit('PREPARE_FAIL='+exc.__class__.__name__+':'+msg)
